verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a state tax agency could publish power-of-attorney or third-party authorization forms, portal delegate roles, and rules on which signatures must stay personal. Nothing in the evidence pack covers any of these. The pack documents only filing, payment, licensing, and change-of-address or amendment forms, none of which address what a representative may do on the taxpayer's behalf.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, exactly what a third party may and may not do on my behalf is published — the authorization forms, the roles, and which signatures stay personal
